svg.title: Popular Scripting 0.2.38 chart domain comparison
svg.desc: Fixture-only comparison at native widget sizes. Before uses the global seven-day window and leaves sparse B3 curves narrow. After uses each series' first and last real visible timestamps while preserving intermediate elapsed-time spacing. No live prices or points are included.
svg.text: Fixture de timestamps · pontos e valores sintéticos · bordas úteis marcadas
Não substitui o render nativo do Scripting nem prova teste físico no iPhone.
